title: Protopine ameliorates OVA-induced asthma through modulatingTLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB pathway and NLRP3 inflammasome-mediated pyroptosis.
authors: Yang, Jing; Zhang, Meixian; Luo, Yumeng; Xu, Feng; Gao, Fan; Sun, Yanping; Yang, Bingyou; Kuang, Haixue
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究普罗托品对OVA诱导哮喘的缓解作用及TLR4/NF-κB通路和NLRP3焦亡机制，属纯药理学与湿实验研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Chronic airway inflammation and hyperresponsiveness are characteristics of asthma. The isoquinoline alkaloid protopine (PRO) has been shown to exert anti-inflammatory effects, but its mechanism of action in asthma is not known. PURPOSE: Investigate the protective properties of PRO upon asthma and elucidate its mechanism. STUDY DESIGN AND METHODS: The effects of PRO in asthma treatment were assessed by histology, biochemical analysis, and real-time reverse transcription-quantitative polymerase chain reaction. Then, we integrated molecular docking, western blotting, cellular experiments, immunohistochemistry, immunofluorescence analysis, flow cytometry, and metabolomics analysis to reveal its mechanism. RESULTS: In vivo, PRO therapy reduced the number of inflammatory cells (eosinophils, leukocytes, monocytes) in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF), ameliorated pathologic alterations in lung tissues, and inhibited secretion of IgG and histamine. Molecular docking showed that PRO could dock with the proteins of TLR4, MyD88, TRAF6, TAK1, IKKalpha, and TNF-alpha. Western blotting displayed that PRO inhibited the TLR4/NF-kappaB signaling pathway. PRO regulated expression of the pyroptosis-related proteins NLR family pyrin domain containing 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome, gasdermin D, caspase-1, and drove caspase-1 inactivation to affect inflammatory responses by inhibiting the NLRP3 inflammasome. In vitro, 24 h after treatment with PRO, cell activity, as well as levels of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and interleukin (IL)-1beta and IL-18, decreased significantly. Immunofluorescence staining showed that PRO decreased expression of TLR4 and MyD88 in vitro. PRO decreased nuclear translocation of NF-kappaB p65. Twenty-one potential biomarkers in serum were identified using metabolomics analysis, and they predominantly controlled the metabolism of phenylalanine, tryptophan, glucose, and sphingolipids. CONCLUSION: PRO reduced OVA-induced asthma. The underlying mechanism was associated with the TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB pathway and NLRP3 inflammasome-mediated pyroptosis.
abstract_zh: 背景：慢性气道炎症和高反应性是哮喘的特征。异喹啉类生物碱原阿片碱（protopine, PRO）已被证明具有抗炎作用，但其在哮喘中的作用机制尚不清楚。目的：研究PRO对哮喘的保护特性并阐明其机制。研究设计与方法：通过组织学、生物化学分析和实时逆转录定量聚合酶链反应评估PRO在哮喘治疗中的效果。然后，我们整合了分子对接、蛋白质印迹、细胞实验、免疫组织化学、免疫荧光分析、流式细胞术和代谢组学分析以揭示其机制。结果：在体内，PRO治疗减少了支气管肺泡灌洗液（BALF）中炎症细胞（嗜酸性粒细胞、白细胞、单核细胞）的数量，改善了肺组织的病理变化，并抑制了IgG和组胺的分泌。分子对接显示PRO可与TLR4、MyD88、TRAF6、TAK1、IKKalpha和TNF-alpha的蛋白质对接。蛋白质印迹显示PRO抑制了TLR4/NF-kappaB信号通路。PRO调节了焦亡相关蛋白NLR家族含吡啶结构域3（NLRP3）炎症小体、gasdermin D、caspase-1的表达，并通过抑制NLRP3炎症小体驱动caspase-1失活以影响炎症反应。在体外，PRO处理24小时后，细胞活性以及活性氧（ROS）和白细胞介素（IL）-1beta和IL-18的水平显著降低。免疫荧光染色显示PRO在体外降低了TLR4和MyD88的表达。PRO减少了NF-kappaB p65的核转位。通过代谢组学分析鉴定了血清中的21种潜在生物标志物，它们主要控制苯丙氨酸、色氨酸、葡萄糖和鞘脂的代谢。结论：PRO减轻了OVA诱导的哮喘。其潜在机制与TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB通路和NLRP3炎症小体介导的焦亡相关。
